The Series

Eleven nights of hope

For eleven evenings, the Cincinnati Ghanaian Seventh-day Adventist Church invites the whole city to gather around one question: where do we find hope that holds? Each night brings clear Bible teaching, music, prayer, and space to ask honest questions.

Come once or come every night. There is no cost, no registration required at the door, and someone will be there to welcome you.

Health Screening

Available every night for your well-being.

Every night — register to secure yours.
